text_block_list.text:
Ever since I officially became Найс Нэйчер's
trainer, we've been
training day in, day
out.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whew, my arms and legs are all wobbly!
Guess that's a personalized
training menu
for you—no punches held.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely feeling this in the morning...
But what's next? Whatcha
got prepared?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
In stark contrast to her usual aloof
demeanor, Найс Нэйчер is diligent
and
eager when it comes to training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hm? Cat got your tongue, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
I was just thinking about what a nice and
hard-working student you are.

text_block_list.text: Huh?! N-nah, it's like... I gotta do what I gotta do, you know? For what it's worth, I am a Tracen student.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
C'mon, stop with the sappy stuff and tell
me what I gotta do next.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
After training like this for a while, our first
challenge comes in the
form of a
scrimmage against other students.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Phew.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Third again...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Even with my own personal trainer, even
after that much
training—third is all I got
in me, huh.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Haha, looks like third place is where I
belong, isn't it?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Goals like staying undefeated or
conquering the Twinkle
Series—they're not
meant for me.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
No way, what're you even saying? I told
you when we first met,
remember? I
haven't got any talent worth writing home
about.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'll still do all the training, and I'll
obviously try my best to win the
races you
sign me up for.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But I understand myself all too well. My
talents as a racer, and my
limits too.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's enough out of me! Look, I
think it's time for me to head
o—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Rumble...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh? Was that you, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't sweat it! A growing
youngster's gotta eat, after all.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I've got it—come with me for a sec! There's
a great place I know.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure I'm older than Nature, but
before I can blurt out a witty
retort, she
grabs my arm and drags me away...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Mmm, smells good! Hey pops, you got any
fresh meatball skewers?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Natie! We got meatball skewers all
right—gizzard, too!
text_block_list.name: Friendly Man

text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds great! Then maybe I'll take
one—wait, no. It's not just me
today!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I want my trainer to try the food here.
Could you whip up some of
your
specialities for me?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
No problem, comin' right up—wait,
whaaat?! You're Natie's Тренер?!
Yer not
pulling my leg, are ya?!
text_block_list.name: Friendly Man

text_block_list.text: Ah, crud...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
How rude of me! Trainer, wait right there!
I'm gon' get the best food
this here
shopping district has to offer!
text_block_list.name: Friendly Man

text_block_list.text:
Uh, you don't gotta—aaand he's gone.
Dang, he's fast. You think he'd
run my
races for me?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Yeesh, I knew this would happen, so I was
trying to avoid saying you
were my trainer.
Man, that was a bust.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
The people of the shopping district really love
you.

text_block_list.text:
Well, you could say that... I mean, even at
Tracen Academy, I try to
be the girl
everyone feels comfortable talking to,
y'know?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Back home, I lived in a shopping district
just like this one. My mom
ran a little bar
there, so I've been helping out since I was
a kid.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Cause of that, I've talked to my fair share
of grown-ups in my time,
from regulars at
the bar to other shopping district
denizens.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
That's probably why people tell me I act
old for my age.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But it's also why I was able to meet so
many friendly old folk, so all in
all, I'm
pretty grateful.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Which reminds me, I wonder how the lady
who ran the sweets shop
back home is
doing? Hope her back isn't bothering her
too much.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She's got a scary face, but she's actually
really nice. When I was little,
she'd always
give me leftover candy from the shop.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: The folks back home must love you too.

text_block_list.text:
Haha... Despite that, I've got no real
talents worth writing home
about.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: In reality... everyone was just being nice.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I was a little bit faster than the local
competition, so they cheered me
on and
hyped me up. And look, it got me all the
way here.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You should've been there the day I left
home. They put up flags and
streamers all
over the shopping district. Said it was a
festival.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But now... just look at me—look at what I
did with all those lofty
expectations.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: All I can get are decent results, like—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Trainer—sorry 'bout the wait! Eat
this and fill yerself right up!
We're leavin'
Natie in yer capable hands!
text_block_list.name: Friendly Man

text_block_list.text:
Haha... You heard him, Trainer. Better eat
up before it gets cold,
'kay?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're here! Heeey, Nature! Whew, I
finally found you!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Hm, Teio? What's the matter?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Haven't you seen the race program?
They put it up already, you
know—for the
Meet!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Oh, the legendary Tracen Meet! Tons of
people come to watch every
year. I can't
wait!
text_block_list.name: Friendly Man

text_block_list.text:
And don't you worry, Natie, all of us are
comin' to cheer you on!
text_block_list.name: Friendly Man

text_block_list.text: Haha, I 'preciate it. I really do. But wow, I didn't think they'd have the program up this fast.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
More importantly... Teio, you came all the
way here just to tell me
that?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, you signed up for the 2000m
turf race, right? Well, I did
too!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
We got put in the same group! So I'm here
to declare war! Nature—it's
you against
me!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I-I'm racing... against you?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
